name: bielu-microservices-orchestrator
description: Root workspace for changeset-driven versioning of the Bielu.Microservices.Orchestrator NuGet suite. Not published. Every NuGet package in this repository shares the single version recorded here and in version.props.

scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/apply-nuget-version.mjs && node scripts/ship-public-api.mjs
scripts.coverage: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('TestResults/coverage',{recursive:true,force:true})" && dotnet test src/Bielu.Microservices.Orchestrator.slnx --results-directory TestResults/coverage && node scripts/coverage.mjs TestResults/coverage --check
